title: Mapp Labs retrofit state
description: State of which labs-app-template retrofits an app has applied. Lives at the repo root of a forked app as `.retrofit-state.json` (committed). Maintained by retrofit agents; readable by a fleet dashboard that scans app repos.

forkedAtVersion.description: Template version this app was originally forked at, if known (a lower bound). e.g. "1.0.12".

forkedAtRef.description: Immutable git ref (tag or commit SHA) the app was forked at, if known. e.g. "v1.0.12".

lastRetrofitAgainstVersion.description: Template version of the fresh checkout the most recent retrofit ran against. e.g. "1.0.24".

lastRetrofitAgainstRef.description: Immutable git ref (tag or commit SHA) of the template checkout the most recent retrofit ran against — exact, unlike the version string. e.g. "v1.0.24" or a commit SHA.

lastRetrofitAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent retrofit activity.

retrofits.description: One entry per retrofit, keyed by its id (the dedicated prompt filename stem, e.g. "2026-06-19-app-router-routing-convention"; for entries handled inline from MIGRATION.md, a MIGRATION-derived date-slug).

status.description: applied = fully done. partial = some sub-changes done / something deferred (see notes). skipped = applicable but the user declined (divergence debt). not-applicable = does not apply to this app. pending = identified as needed, not yet done.

templateVersion.description: Template version this entry was applied/evaluated against.

templateRef.description: Immutable git ref (tag or commit SHA) this entry was applied/evaluated against.

capability.description: Cross-reference to the registry capability id this retrofit maps to (docs/template/capabilities/_registry.json), when applicable — e.g. "client_catalog", "upc", "data_sync", "company_login". Omit for foundational/infra retrofits with no capability. NOTE: the app's enabled-capabilities list is NOT duplicated here — that stays authoritative in app.config.json (enabledCapabilities).

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for this entry's last update.

by.description: Who/what made the change, e.g. "claude-agent" or a person's handle.

notes.description: Free text: why skipped/not-applicable, what was deferred, or any app-specific decision.

deviations.description: Specific points where the app intentionally diverged from the template's reference approach, and why.
